### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import pandas as pd

def pandas_read_csv(data: dict) -> dict:
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    return {'records': df.to_dict(orient='records'), 'shape': [int(df.shape[0]), int(df.shape[1])], 'columns': list(df.columns)}
```
